name: asm-tool
description: Web-based attack surface management for crewai.com

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w asm-server" "npm run dev -w asm-dashboard"
scripts.start: npm run build -w asm-dashboard && npm run start -w asm-server
scripts.test: npm test -w asm-server && npm test -w asm-dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w asm-server && npm run typecheck -w asm-dashboard
